records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Net sales for the third quarter of fiscal 2023 increased 4.3% to $3.41 billion from $3.27 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Comparable store sales for the third quarter of fiscal 2023 decreased 0.4%.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: We usually experience our highest inventory and accounts payable balances during our first fiscal quarter for purchases of seasonal products to support the higher sales volume of the spring selling season, and again during our third fiscal quarter to support the higher sales volume of the cold weather selling season.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: As a percent of net sales, gross margin in the third quarter of fiscal 2023 increased 101 basis points to 36.7% from 35.6% in the third quarter of fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Operating income for the third quarter of fiscal 2023 increased 11.3% to $340.9 million from $306.4 million in the third quarter of fiscal 2022.
